description: This file defines a static class 'CosmosIdSanitizer' that provides methods for sanitizing and unsanitizing strings intended for use as identifiers in Cosmos DB within the Orleans project. It handles encoding and decoding special characters to ensure safe storage and retrieval of IDs, with conditional namespace based on compile-time flags.

classes.name: CosmosIdSanitizer
classes.description: A static utility class for sanitizing and desanitizing string identifiers used in Cosmos DB, ensuring special characters are properly escaped and restored.

methods.name: Sanitize
methods.description: Replaces special characters in the input string with escape sequences to make it safe for Cosmos DB.

methods.name: Unsanitize
methods.description: Reverses the sanitization process, restoring original characters from escape sequences in the input string.
